name: OUTCOME_MED_ADHERE_INFO
description: This table will hold med adherence information around the medications associated with an outcome.

columns.name: REGISTRY_DATA_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the registry data record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: OUTCOME_KEY_MED_ADH
columns.description: This item stores the outcome's key. This key is unique for an outcome on a particular RDI record. This item is used to link the current outcomes group (I RDI 42010) with the med adherence data stored here.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_NAME
columns.description: The medication name relevant to an adherence measure.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_NDC_ID
columns.description: The NDC record ID for the medication listed.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_NDC_ID_NDC_CODE
columns.description: The external code for the National Drug Code (NDC). An NDC represents packages of medications.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_FIRST_FILL_DATE
columns.description: The date this medication was first filled.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_LAST_FILL_DATE
columns.description: The most recent fill date for the medication.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_NEXT_FILL_DATE
columns.description: The expected next fill date for the medication. This is based on last fill date + days supplied.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_DAYS_SUPPLY
columns.description: The number of days that the latest medication fill should last if taken as prescribed.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_ELIG_EXT_DAY_SUP_C_NAME
columns.description: Whether the patient is eligible for a larger medication supply.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_REFILLS_REMAINING
columns.description: The number of refills a patient can obtain before their provider must authorize more.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_PRESCRIBER_NAME
columns.description: The name of the provider who prescribed the medication.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_PRESCRIBER_NPI
columns.description: The National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the provider who prescribed the medication.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_PRESCRIBER_PHONE
columns.description: The phone number of the provider who prescribed the medication.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_PHARMACY_NAME
columns.description: The name of the pharmacy where the patient obtained the medication.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_PHARMACY_NPI
columns.description: The National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the pharmacy where the patient obtained the medication.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_PHARMACY_PHONE
columns.description: The phone number of the pharmacy where the patient obtained the medication.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_PHARMACY_SRC_C_NAME
columns.description: The method of distribution used by the pharmacy where the patient obtained the medication.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_PREF_PHARMACY_YN
columns.description: Whether the pharmacy where the patient obtained the medication is a preferred pharmacy for the payer. Patients often have lower out-of-pocket costs at preferred pharmacies.
